[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if a % 10 = 0 ∨ b % 10 = 0 then 0
else
  let unit_a := a % 10
  let unit_b := b % 10
  let product := unit_a * unit_b
  if product < 0 then product + 100 else product
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma mod_10_zero_or_non_zero
(a: Int):
(a % 10 = 0) ∨ (a % 10 ≠ 0) :=
by
  linarith
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation a b
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_unit_a := mod_10_zero_or_non_zero a
have h_unit_b := mod_10_zero_or_non_zero b
by_cases h_a_unit_0: a % 10 = 0
-- Case 1: a % 10 = 0
simp [h_a_unit_0]
by_cases h_b_unit_0: b % 10 = 0
simp [h_b_unit_0]
linarith
have h_b_unit_non_0: ¬ b % 10 = 0 := by
  linarith
linarith
have h_b_unit_non_0': b % 10 ≠ 0 := by
  linarith
have h_b_product_0: result % (b % 10) = 0 := by
  simp [h_b_unit_non_0']
  simp [implementation]
  linarith
have h_b_product_100: (result / (b % 10)) % 100 = b % 10 := by
  simp [h_b_unit_non_0']
  simp [implementation]
  linarith
linarith
-- Case 2: a % 10 ≠ 0
have h_a_unit_non_0: a % 10 ≠ 0 := by
  linarith
have h_a_product_0: result % (a % 10) = 0 := by
  simp [h_a_unit_non_0]
  simp [implementation]
  linarith
have h_a_product_100: (result / (a % 10)) % 100 = a % 10 := by
  simp [h_a_unit_non_0]
  simp [implementation]
  linarith
linarith
have h_a_unit_0_b_unit_0: a % 10 = 0 ∧ b % 10 = 0 := by
  simp [h_a_unit_0, h_b_unit_0]
have h_product_0: (a * b) % 10 = 0 := by
  simp [h_a_unit_0_b_unit_0]
  simp [Int.mod_mul]
  linarith
simp [h_product_0]
linarith
[END]
